title: Feature Request: When there is bolus delivery make cancel button enabled configurable
body:
When there is bolus delivery make cancel button configurable. 

So when bolus is running there is cancel button there. This button is always enabled... With new t:mobi pump we have problem that pump supports cancelling, but only from certain point.

So I have solution for this ready, and this ticket is merly so that we can track PR for that... What I have done is, to add new event (EventOverviewBolusStopDeliveryEnabled), which can disable/enable cancel button. Event has one parameter isEnabled, so that you can enable or disable that button.

I will push PR in next few days...
